info.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise Qlik Sense Service About Virtual Proxy API
Qlik Sense Enterprise List virtual proxy configurations

params.name: Xrfkey
params.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention key. Must be 16 arbitrary characters matching the X-Qlik-Xrfkey header value.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter expression using the syntax: property operator value. Supports operators like eq, ne, so, ew, sw. Example: name eq 'MyApp'

params.name: privileges
params.description: Whether to append privilege information to the returned entities.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of all virtual proxy configurations.

info.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise Create virtual proxy configuration

params.name: Xrfkey
params.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention key. Must be 16 arbitrary characters matching the X-Qlik-Xrfkey header value.

items.docs: Creates a new virtual proxy configuration with authentication and session handling settings.

info.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise Get virtual proxy configuration by ID

params.name: Xrfkey
params.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention key. Must be 16 arbitrary characters matching the X-Qlik-Xrfkey header value.

items.docs: Retrieves a single virtual proxy configuration by its unique identifier.

info.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise Update virtual proxy configuration

params.name: Xrfkey
params.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention key. Must be 16 arbitrary characters matching the X-Qlik-Xrfkey header value.

items.docs: Updates an existing virtual proxy configuration.
